name: Cryo / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Three spreading brittle ice fractures, then a delicate cold crystalline ring over sustained ice crackling and fine falling frost grains. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
